title: How the body processes a drug: connections
description: Sort 16 words from class 3 into four groups.

groups.name: Places in the body
groups.explanation: Parts of the body where a drug travels or is processed.

groups.name: Taking a medicine
groups.explanation: Words about how and how much medicine you take.

groups.name: What happens to the drug
groups.explanation: Steps a drug goes through in the body.

groups.name: Effect and control
groups.explanation: Words about how well a drug works and how it can change.
